name: hatfield_canon
purpose: Structured Hatfield Group canon for product, venue, cocktail, ownership, distribution, public-knowledge, and renderer/MCP lookup.

collections.group: Hatfield Group ownership, scale, leadership, source conflicts, and relationship to Walker Holdings.
collections.divisions: Operating divisions, scale, revenue, employee counts, leaders, public scale, and Alex relationship.
collections.products: Canon product catalogue across bourbon, Limestone Springs, Scotland spirits, wines, provisions, barware, merchandise, and future/not-for-sale products.
collections.venues: Company-owned and planned venues across restaurants, inns, clubs, distilleries, Still House, wine estates, and production facilities.
collections.cocktails: Hatfield cocktail recipe guide sourced from data/hatfield/hatfield_cocktails.csv.
collections.franchise_operations: Franchise terms, open locations, buildout/signed locations, support operations, financials, and projections.
collections.distribution_and_channels: Sales channels, geography, product-category revenue, and captive Hatfield supply channels.
collections.public_knowledge: What the public knows, what is not public, and how product photos should be interpreted.
collections.business_renderer_contract: Required files, lookup policy, and example answers for Hatfield scenes.
